notes.title: Demo Completion Soon
notes.content:
*  A small segment of the Hero mechanic has been released for each of the seven factions. This feature will be more expansive when the game releases for early access and I appreciate the testing that has been conducted. Although the Hero mechanic is just a placeholder in the demo it is very much alive and receiving iterations. 

*  A location placeholder has been added to the game similar to the Hero mechanic and is not operational outside of it being cosmetically placed on the battlefield. Please let me know if you think the color, size, or formatting is pleasing to the eye. 

*  I have made many iterations on the AI to prevent freezing and the latest update serves as another iteration of the AI logic and hopefully it resolves the intermittent freezing that can occur.

*  Updated the Avatar Design. I know it will appear smaller in-game and am considering adjusting the size to ensure it not only looks appealing but generally fits within the games UI and design philosophy.

*Lastly I will be making one more update to the demo before transitioning to some game altering changes that will be developed for early access. I want to thank everyone who has taking the tie to play the game (whichever state you played it in) and hope to see you for the last update and launch.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: Infinite Origin Demo Update #2
notes.content:
Sorry for the issues over the last 24 hours. I have hopefully resolved the AI freezing issue. But as a side effect I am restricting access to deckbuilding and card collection. I am also preventing access to the other four factions for further testing.

I did add the aforementioned Hero System which is still early in development but adds a nice look to the board. 

I will continue to update this Demo, but the cadence will be on a case-by-case basis so please be patient for additional access.

Thank You for your interest and I am working endlessly to ensure Infinite Origin can compete with the Kings of this Genre!!!

notes.title: Demo Update Incoming
notes.content:
* Adding 4 complete factions to the demo for testing.
* Adding some music and sound effects to the demo for better immersion.
* Bug fixes and refinements.

notes.title: Future Update - Heroes
notes.content:
In the early stages of having all Avatars within the game to have a corresponding hero card that is playable with unique abilities and functions. Stay Tuned!
